Sapa Life Restaurant, Sapa Hidden corner gem in Sapa
Jul 2026 • Couples
Sapa Life popped up in one of my feeds while we were in Sapa, the reviews looked good and it was very convenient for our accommodation. Sapa Life could be easily missed as it sits back in a corner very close to the funicular building.
Sapa Life offer a wide choice of food and offer some western style meals for those challenged or perhaps just missing home?
I tried the Sapa Potato soup, chicken noodle soup (Pho Ga by another name) and my wife ordered the Sapa spring rolls. The food was lovely, the prices very reasonable and the staff couldn’t do more for us.
We were trying to sample other restaurants in Sapa (the choice is extensive!!) but could not recommend making the effort to find this hidden corner and a gem of a restaurant.

Dull and dry “European” menu
Feb 2026 • Couples
We came here based on good reviews and we wanted a change from the normal Vietnamese fare. I ordered spaghetti carbonara which was totally bland and my husband ordered a burger that was a tiny square dry overcooked piece of meat on an oversized bun. It was bad. Maybe their Vietnamese food is better but I would not eat here for their other offerings. They were checking with other diners and only asking the people who said their food was good to leave reviews.
